scores.overall_note: The package splits into two contradictory halves. The source describes a well-matched product for the brief — a single-document structured editor whose editor pane, preview pane, validation pill, and Markdown/JSON export all derive from one model, with a 2000-op invariant fuzz script and keyboard-journey tooling aimed squarely at the acceptance seed '结构化编辑与预览一致' (source/src/App.jsx, source/src/model.js, source/scripts/verify-model.mjs). The delivered artifact, however, is an empty page: both operator screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show only the body background color with zero content, and the sanitized receipt reports target_invalid=true with all seven checks skipped, so nothing about the running product — salience, comprehension, layout, or accessibility — can be positively evidenced. The immediate cause is visible in the deliverable itself: the entry HTML loads raw /src/main.jsx and no dist/ build ships in the package, so a direct static open cannot execute the app despite the brief requiring a directly openable artifact that is usable at load. Perceptual and defect dimensions are scored on the blank delivery; the structural dimensions are scored from source with one notch held back for zero runtime corroboration; accessibility is null because its evidence channels (receipt checks and visible affordances) are both absent. Per protocol, these are model-judged observations of an anonymous package, not human-preference data, and no claim is made about how the package was produced.
